objective: Restore readable text in BUKLOD Faith Learning Portal, lesson readers, progress and locked lessons, Word list and detail on Android system dark mode without changing global appearance or business logic.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: source parent GitHub main SHA 404c87e55c62a88c95c7389ac8665f237149702a matches recorded verified Nov 18 Train A production source; this PR does not publish or claim new production OTA.
chosenApproach: Introduce a restricted light legacy-text compatibility surface only for seven Faith/Learning modules. Keep global themed Card for other domains; retain all current learning APIs and ad behaviors.
selectionRationale: Night Pine/Graphite theme surfaces darken shared Card while legacy text in these educational routes remains fixed dark, causing near-invisible type in five Android screenshots.
preserveBehaviors: No modifications to learning grade or server auto-approval, BP/points, activity submissions or offline caching.
Existing dark palettes, global Card, Connect, Wall, AdMob and dashboard navigation remain unchanged.
Existing lesson locking and status reporting remain; only whole-card fading removed.
No production OTA, Season 2 gameplay, auth, migrations, or deployment permission changes.
acceptanceChecks: Node and Jest checks verify text contrast >=4.5:1 on Faith content and scoped aliases.
Engineering Accountability and protected-feature-lock gate PASS using this exact V2 manifest.
TypeScript and protected AdMob, navigation and compact layout gates PASS.
Android light/dark manual/automated screenshot, safe-area and rendered-ad verification required before any OTA.
Staging RC release first; production gated by exact Android runtime, manifest and OTA identity.
